Claims: owner identified by host, /etc/machine-id, boot time, pid namespace, pid and process start; an owner whose liveness cannot be checked (other host, container, sandbox, no machine-id) is 'foreign' and needs --clear-foreign-claims; only verifiably dead owners are 'stale' (--clear-stale-claims). Outputs that break the fitter/scorer contract are moved to OUT/quarantine/, never deleted. Fits read a snapshot of the manifest (OUT/manifests/<sha>.tsv).
